blockingIssues.description: Startup hardening for browser validators is incomplete: timeout/heartbeat guidance was improved, but deterministic bootstrap for known launcher/runtime-linker failures is still not codified in flow-validator instructions. Review evidence shows browser startup still failed on missing libnspr4 and required ad-hoc manual workaround.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add mission-planning guidance to avoid assigning validation-infrastructure-only features to fullstack-worker, or explicitly define an approved procedure for such assignments, to reduce repeated skill-procedure drift.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Two reviewed features in this milestone (misc-validation-flow-validator-timeout-hardening and misc-agent-browser-runtime-deps-bootstrap) were assigned fullstack-worker but changed only .factory validation assets/scripts and both reviews flagged predictable procedure misalignment.

rejectedObservations.observation: The assigned fullstack-worker skill procedure does not fit validation-infrastructure-only features.
